"""One-off for W2-151 (never committed): run gov links --all, count findings by code, list MR-* lines."""
import collections
import os
import subprocess
import sys

tree = "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-151"
label = sys.argv[1]
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=tree + "/src")
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "gov.cli.main", "links", "--all"],
                      cwd=tree, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
out = proc.stdout + proc.stderr
with open(f"{tree}/.gov-runtime/scratch/w2-151-links-{label}.txt", "w") as fh:
    fh.write(out)
lines = out.splitlines()
print("exit", proc.returncode)
print(lines[0] if lines else "(no output)")
counts = collections.Counter(l.split()[0] for l in lines[1:] if l.strip())
for code, n in sorted(counts.items()):
    print(code, n)
print("--- master-rules lines ---")
for l in lines:
    if "master-rules" in l or l.split()[:2][-1:] and l.split()[1:2] and l.split()[1].startswith("MR-"):
        print(l)
